item.title: Version 0.19.6
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.19.6

Bug Fixes

  • Recently visited links now appear in every space, instead of only the space where you first opened them.
  • Clearing your Recents list no longer deletes saved links you had visited.
  • The sidebar no longer freezes at full CPU when you scroll and click inside nested folders.
  • Quitting a browser no longer causes it to relaunch on its own.
  • Clicking the X, Open With button, or a browser pill on a saved link no longer also opens the link.
